property: Ol Pejeta Conservancy (general contract - conservancy fees, Pelican House, The Stables, Camping, Conservation Experiences)
sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OL PEJETA/2026 OL PEJETA CONTRACT RATES_.pdf
notes: This is the Conservancy's own general contract covering entry fees plus THREE distinct accommodation/activity products it operates directly (Pelican House self-catering cottage, The Stables budget lodge, Camping) - separate from 'Ol Pejeta Safari Cottages' (a different, privately-run luxury cottage operator on the same conservancy, see ol-pejeta-safari-cottages-2026.json).
Conservancy gates are cashless; entry/vehicle fees are not commissionable.
gateHours: Entry/exit strictly via Rongai and Serat gates, 07:00-19:00 daily

pelicanHouse.description: Exclusive self-catering house, sleeps 8, overlooking Pelican Dam, east of conservancy
pelicanHouse.commission: 15% (self-catering); NOT available on fully-catered option's catering costs

fullyCateredSupplement.raw: Extra KES5,000 (residents) / US$50 (non-residents) per person per night, non-commissionable, added to self-catering charges. Excludes drinks.

chefOption.raw: Extra KES3,500 (residents) / US$50 (non-residents) per day, non-commissionable, for a cook to help with breakfast/lunch/dinner (on top of self-catering rate, without full catering).

theStables.description: Budget accommodation: 12 single rooms (shared bathrooms/toilets), 2 double rooms, 1 twin room (ensuite)
theStables.includes: Breakfast, lunch (Kenyan style), dinner, tea/coffee all day, boiled drinking water, fridge for residents
theStables.childPolicy: Child rate applies to children sharing a double room with 2+ adults (rate not separately itemized beyond the room rate structure)

camping.description: 5 campsites; site rental includes exclusive use of campsite, firewood, water bowser, toilet facilities

conservationExperiences_1Jan_31Dec2026.childRestrictions: Not permitted for children: Dog Tracking, Behind the Scene Chimpanzee, Rhino Monitoring, Guided Bush Walk. Minimum age 12.

immersiveConservationExperiencePrograms.description: Multi-day/week volunteer-style programs. Inclusive of conservancy entry fees, daily hosting/guiding, all accommodation and food at The Stables, safari vehicle use within conservancy, accommodation, and conservation activities.

policies.cancellation_stablesPelicanImmersive: 60-31 days: 20% of total booking value; 30-8 days: 30%; within 7 days: 100%
policies.payment_stablesPelicanImmersive: Booking within 7 days of arrival: full payment immediately. Booking 1+ month prior: 30% deposit within 7 days, balance in full at least 7 days before arrival.
